name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Minipod 2-6 Person Cabin Sauna
description: Escape to Pure Relaxation with the Canadian Timber Minipod Discover the ultimate relaxation retreat with the Canadian Timber Minipod Sauna by Dundalk Leisurecraft. Handcrafted from premium Canadian Eastern White Cedar, this compact yet luxurious sauna offers a serene space for unwinding and rejuvenating. Key Features at a Glance Premium Eastern White Cedar Sustainably sourced and expertly selected for its resistance to decay, natural insulation properties, and beautiful tight knot grain, Eastern White Cedar provides a luxurious and durable sauna experience. Black Asphalt Shingle Roof The Minipod is built to last, with a protective black asphalt shingle roof that enhances durability in all weather conditions. Compact & Easy to Assemble Measuring 7×7 feet (184 cm), the Minipod's compact design makes it a perfect fit for small spaces. It arrives as a convenient, ready-to-assemble kit and can be set up in approximately 8 hours. Comfortable Side Wall Benches Designed for 4 people sitting up or 2 people lying down, the side benches offer both flexibility and comfort, allowing you to fully relax in the warmth. Videos Lead Times Dundalk Leisurecraft saunas are luxurious saunas handcrafted in Canada with sustainably sourced Canadian lumber. Due to this, these saunas are made to order, which means there isn't any inventory. Current lead time is 6-8 weeks to ship. Warranty The Canadian Timber Collection by Dundalk LeisureCraft Inc. saunas are warranted against defects in materials and workmanship under normal/residential use for a period of three (3) years, as applicable, from the date of receipt of the product. This warranty does not apply to normal wear and tear and/or natural weather conditions. This warranty does not cover regular required maintenance of the sauna, (eg. Tightening bands on the barrels, cleaning or staining the sauna) refer to your sauna assembly manual for maintenance guidelines. This warranty does not cover misuse or negligence and the manufacturer and associated retailers are not liable for any injury or damage caused by the product. This warranty is a parts-only warranty and any service or labor costs would not be considered part of the 3-year warranty.
